reason: The rover is meant to deliver the last invitation, so it seems like the natural way to welcome the guests first.
expectation: The rover will deliver or draw the final invitation before the fair opens.

effect: The rover made the welcome banner rather than interacting directly with the fair; the banner is now ready to use.
reaction: The looping border and Kit’s hatted whale are a satisfying welcome.
reason: The finished banner belongs at the fair, so I’ll try putting it there.
expectation: The welcome banner will be displayed at the fair.

effect: The banner is now on the grounded cradle, clear of the tether lines; the two controls remain to be used.
reaction: It is reassuring that the banner does not obstruct the tethers.
reason: I’ll try starting the attractions while the whale is still grounded, before lifting it.
expectation: The dragon and star theatre will start running.

alternatives.reason: I could lift the whale first, but testing the attractions on the ground seems sensible.

effect: The dragon and star projector are running; the lift control is the remaining apparent step.
reaction: Seeing the attractions work before flight is satisfying.
reason: The show is running, so I’ll use the lift control to open the flying fair.
expectation: The tethered whale will rise and the flying fair will open.

effect: The lift control raised the tethered whale and completed the flying fair, bringing the chapter’s goal to an end.
reaction: The dragon waving beneath its own projected stars is a satisfying payoff to the assembled show.

mostWorthwhile.text: Starting the attractions and then lifting the whale brought the separate mechanisms together in a memorable finale.

leastWorthwhile.text: My first attempt was the least informative choice: I guessed the rover would interact with the fair, but it needed the banner instead.

surprise.text: I expected the rover to deliver an invitation, so its drawing the banner’s looping border instead was a small surprise.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely arbitrary, though my initial choice of the fair as the rover’s partner was a guess rather than a clearly indicated connection.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter offered new mechanisms to explore; this short finale was satisfying, but mostly used things already built.
